title: Schedule of Lease-End Terms to the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Master Agreement
content:
# Schedule of Lease-End Terms — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

This schedule states, for each program tier of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, the notice periods that govern a unit's turn-in and the closed-end commercial figures that apply when a closed-end unit's lease ends.

## Part A — Notice and turn-in periods

Written notice of termination must be given the stated number of calendar days before a unit is turned in, and the unit must be turned in within the stated number of calendar days after the notice or the notice lapses. Both figures are the same in every tier.

| Item | Every program tier |
|---|---|
| Termination notice required before turn-in | 30 calendar days |
| Latest turn-in after the notice before it lapses | 60 calendar days |

## Part B — Closed-end commercial figures by tier

| Program tier | Closed-end early termination fee (USD) | Cap on wear charges, percent of capitalized cost |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Business Advantage | 750 | 10 |
| Kestrel Fleet Select | 750 | 10 |
| Kestrel Fleet Preferred | 650 | 8 |
| Kestrel Fleet Premier | 600 | 8 |
| Kestrel Fleet Enterprise | 500 | 6 |
| Kestrel National Fleet | 500 | 6 |

The closed-end early termination fee is the fee for a closed-end commercial unit ended before its scheduled term.

## Part C — Closed-end excess mileage rates by vehicle class

The excess mileage rate for closed-end commercial units is per mile and is the same in every tier.

| Vehicle class | Rate per mile (USD) |
|---|---|
| Light-duty pickup | 0.25 |
| Cargo van | 0.25 |
| Passenger van | 0.25 |
| SUV | 0.25 |
| Sedan | 0.20 |
| Medium-duty chassis | 0.35 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. Parts A and C do not vary by tier; Part B does.
2. **Hypothetical illustration.** A closed-end unit with a hypothetical capitalized cost of 50000 in Kestrel Fleet Premier has a wear-charge cap of 8 percent of that cost, 4000; the same unit in Kestrel Fleet Enterprise has a cap of 6 percent, 3000.
